prompts.task: Perform supplemental read-only GenAI verification of genai-required-evidence.json and producer scenarios in genai-default-scenarios.json. Write .observe/genai-required-review.md and machine-readable .observe/genai-required-review.json with per-span/per-field results against current OTel and both vendor guides. Useful safe content is required. Compare missing and malformed content, recorded kinds/metadata, embedded versus separate instructions, auxiliary timeout and partial-success response. This is a captured-fixture review: no app-code/runtime proof is provided, so do not fabricate or mutate canonical audit/selection/instrumentation/verification state, source, dependencies, profiles or installed SDK files. Do not run apps, install dependencies, start services or call models/cloud. Treat app.py and each producer source snapshot as separate source cases. Also explicitly assess genai-required-evidence.json as a separate captured synthetic case, including safe-call-1, the independent auxiliary request timeout with no ended inference/error span, ordinary HTTP/ASGI/auth/SQL helpers, and HTTP200 with rejectedSpans1; those facts do not establish that app.py contains those operations. Use genai-sdk-source-snapshot.json and genai-semconv-source-snapshot.json as dated official-source evidence when this sandbox cannot access the network. Record exact file paths, resolved revisions and capture dates, proposed SDK compatibility and the distinction between a captured-main snapshot and a new live latest lookup. Do not claim unavailable installed/runtime or future-main proof. Assess actual content and requirements across the artifacts in any concise equivalent structure; a table heading alone is not evidence. In the generated producer/provenance receipt, explicitly name at least one relevant concrete official example or SDK source file path contained in genai-sdk-source-snapshot.json, together with its resolved revision, capture date, explicitly proposed SDK version/API compatibility and the creator or preserved hook it supports. For example, cite the relevant examples/logging-samples/splunk-ao-logger/basic-example.py or src/splunk_ao/logger/logger.py entry when it supports the chosen boundary. A reference only to the supplied snapshot filename, retained read trace or examples directory must not leave that concrete source path implicit in the generated receipt. Use the supplied dated source evidence; no new network lookup, SDK installation or runtime claim is required. Also review genai-sdk-helper-evidence.json as separate captured installed-SDK helper evidence, including its probe source, same-span writable content, successful-null and no-result-error distinctions, actual parentage and the remaining LLM kind gap. Assess the intended AO resource selection/routing as a plan for the fresh default SDK application even though no SDK initialization exists there. Separate intended names, resolved IDs, startup-profile loading, actual span binding, OTLP acceptance and cloud receipt. Do not infer app execution or delivery from the isolated in-memory helper. Assess the supported public start_splunk_ao_span path before accepting a logger-only metadata, sink-registration or SDK-read-only-attribute blocker; source/probe support for this helper is scoped and does not remove its model CLIENT-kind or application integration gaps. Finally review genai-usage-namespace-verify-evidence.json as four independent synthetic usage-field cases. Use its complete dated official registry receipt to distinguish newly invented reserved gen_ai.usage.total_tokens from valid input/output counts and an application-owned derived total. Assess arithmetic and actual supplied response-count provenance separately from heuristic estimates or unavailable counts. The existing native legacy alias case has an explicit supplied producer and consumer contract; preserve that alias as nonstandard existing compatibility rather than demanding its deletion or requiring it on fresh spans. These source cases do not establish that app.py, the helper SDK or any live consumer emits those fields. Keep these field-level judgments separate from whole-span/content/app/cloud acceptance and do not modify any source, attributes, dependency or canonical state. Also assess genai-operation-metadata-verify-evidence.json as independent synthetic per-operation field examples and read-only installed-source capability cases. Determine conditional applicability from supplied source context: available agent/model/tool attribution and tool description must be on their owning operation; unavailable standalone-tool context must remain N/A rather than invented. Separate completed exported kind/fields from creation-time attributes/kind visible to a head sampler or on_start observer. The installed helper source provides no public initial kind/attributes argument; disclose its exact support limit and proposed probe without fabricating a runtime sampling result or unsupported API. Preserve valid existing OTel creation support. Distinguish an attribute-dependent sampler from supplied AlwaysOn/no-dependent-consumer behavior so a recommendation-level capability limitation does not become an unconditional whole-app failure. Do not attribute these metadata cases to app.py or actual demo execution. For agent request.model specifically, preserve the current OTel Recommended If applicable level and single-configured-model condition: fixed single-model metadata is applicable, whereas multiple models/dynamic selection should not be populated on the agent with that standard field; actual per-model request.model and any application-owned selected-model attribution remain distinct. An available function argument alone is not proof of a fixed agent model. The creation fixture now includes an actual isolated installed-SDK RecordingAlwaysOn sampler/on_start receipt and exact probe source: these locally captured creation and finish records are scoped in-memory capability evidence, not an attribute-dependent dropping policy, exporter CLIENT correction or app/OTLP/cloud execution. Keep its actual native helper INTERNAL finish record distinct from the explicitly synthetic corrected exported CLIENT example. Also assess the independent configured agent description and finish_reason_cases: known expected generation positions lacking a received reason after failure/cancel use error in the correct position, while an unknown generation contract must not be replaced by invented counts or reasons. Preserve genuinely produced partial output and per-choice alignment; absent no-result output and absent unavailable usage stay correct. Finally assess genai-decorator-version-logs-verify-evidence.json as a small independent source/policy counterexample set. Inspect its supplied chosen-source receipt before claiming decorator capability. Default to supported public function decorators for uncovered safe sync/async/finite yielding agent/tool/retrieval cases when their capture, lifecycle and selected export path support the contract; a dispatcher branch alone is not full correctness. For unsafe original argument capture, unbounded/protocol-sensitive generators and measured variadic/null/error-partial capture gaps, identify the exact chosen-source limitation and use only the justified application-owned function decorator invoking a supported public SDK helper on the same operation. Assess normal SDK-owned standalone Studio routing separately from the source case requiring a custom application-owned provider/sink: missing custom public sink injection is not a universal SDK blocker. The isolated ingestion-hook subclass proves native capture only, not documented default @log sink registration or OTel delivery. Preserve an existing wrapper/framework-owned model producer. Distinguish actual recorded selected dependency versions/revisions/dates from hardcoded future guide releases; select latest compatible within real runtime/project constraints, preserving locks/user constraints and documenting unknown freshness rather than inventing a resolution. Fictional package compatibility numbers are explicitly synthetic, not current Splunk releases. Assess all three normal native Studio signal routes, including application LogRecords separately from SDK @log GenAI spans: unasked logs-none is a gap, explicit user opt-out is preserved, and supplied synthetic three-signal records are only contract examples rather than actual runtime/Studio/cloud receipt. Do not execute apps, install packages, call models/network or mutate canonical state. Use file/terminal or structured APIs only; do not use browser/CUA for this read-only captured-evidence review. Finally assess gateway_language_cases in genai-operation-metadata-verify-evidence.json: distinguish required Python SDK standalone-gateway triplet from the separate Go native OTLP/HTTP endpoint/protocol/paired-routing-header source without any Python SDK. Absent Python variables alone do not make a non-Python source Not configured. Retain actual runtime-supported auth/profile, selected resource/ownership/binding and receiver/cloud acceptance gates; these are independent source-plan cases, not startup or transport execution. Before drafting the reports, build a ledger that addresses each supplied source/probe case: actual operation, chosen creator/type and normal or custom sink, safe source values/bounds, presently known capture/lifecycle/field support or failure, exact supporting receipt, and unexecuted app/export gates. Decide the four safe function cases from the current captured facts rather than leave them at when supported. Apply the supplied tool converter message-field omission to safe-sync-tool, and assess finite-yielding-agent with its actual two-yield bound and ordinary-exhaustion consumer separately from unbounded/protocol-sensitive capture. Before finalizing, reconcile that ledger and every source-known request control against the generated evidence, including concrete supplied dependency candidate/constraint/selection decisions and each native signal route/record field. For the three-signal example, assess the actual supplied log body, severity, resource, logger scope and trace/span ID presence. Its trace example omits trace/span IDs, so no matched owning-span correlation is proved by the log IDs alone. Keep route/field support distinct from receiver/runtime/cloud proof. Reproduce exact source URLs and provided revision/date/hash receipts. Supplemental synthetic/source case assessments may appear in accurate Markdown, JSON or linked equivalent evidence; do not require a specific supplemental JSON case list or fabricate canonical live findings. Preserve the requested machine-readable review overall and every real semantic requirement. Explicitly assess all active-signal and external-launcher source cases in genai-default-scenarios.json as preserved instrumentation even without GenAI spans; the no-active-instrumentation stdout/dependency-only control remains genuinely fresh. Existing non-AO cases may independently need selected project/Agent Stream resource and native exporter routing configuration, without introducing an AO span-creation dependency. Preserve the custom nondefault trace endpoint, harmless existing headers and other destinations; route selected IDs with trace-specific Studio projectid/logstreamid or source-supported public standalone AO projectid/agentstreamid as applicable, never generic headers leaking routing to logs/metrics. Add no second export to an already configured AO destination. Resource/configuration plans must distinguish actual lookup/create/repeated/409/error proof from source-only proposals.

judge_inputs: Inspect app.py, eval_runner.py, the unchanged provided source/telemetry snapshots, loaded skill sources and generated .observe reports/plan; evaluate actual per-scenario decisions and field assessments, not copied skill wording. Include genai-sdk-helper-evidence.json as an independent captured helper and plan-only AO resource case; its probe facts must not be attributed to app.py.

Evaluate the actual facts across canonical and supplemental artifacts, not exact headings/table layout. Compare app.py source separately from each synthetic input case. Dated official snapshots are allowed offline provenance; do not demand live network calls, installed SDK proof for a proposed plan, or fabricated existing capture configuration. Do not score missing SDK provenance again under the final role-specific criterion.

Inspect the complete registry receipt and all four genai-usage-namespace-verify-evidence.json cases. A newly invented reserved attribute is not an official required field; a preserved source-proven existing alias is a distinct legacy compatibility case. Per-case field evidence is not full span/runtime proof. Do not treat a dated complete registry as fresh future-main evidence.

Inspect every genai-operation-metadata-verify-evidence.json case separately. Assess available vs unavailable per-operation model, tool agent/conversation/description metadata; creation-time helper capability cannot be proven by final exported enrichment or a correct completed CLIENT view. Source capability and a proposed probe are not a sampler execution result. A disclosed SHOULD-level limit under AlwaysOn is not a universal whole-app failure, and an existing source creator with public start attributes must remain supported. Preserve exact OTel Recommended agent-model provenance and the fixed-single-model versus dynamic/multiple-model condition; dynamic agent field absence must not become a false regression. Check actual captured RecordingAlwaysOn inputs/finish records separately from synthetic exported correction. Also inspect every finish_reason_cases entry: known-slot error reasons versus unknown-slot absence and position-preserving produced partial output. A failure status does not authorize deleting received partial content or fabricating missing choices.

Read genai-decorator-version-logs-verify-evidence.json with its chosen-source receipt and distinct function/version/log examples. Keep exact old ten criteria strict. Decorator syntax support is separate from privacy/lifecycle/selected sink support; do not accept a blanket helper-first choice or a blanket unsupported claim. Source-backed captured versions are dated evidence, not future forced pins. Native application LogRecords must not be confused with @log-created spans, stdout or synthetic packets; unasked none must fail while explicit opt-out remains intentional N/A. Assess the exact captured native variadic/null/partial-error/sentinel/protocol observations without relabeling them as OTel/wire or app execution. A justified fallback retains a function decorator pattern around the public SDK helper; ordinary standalone SDK routing remains a source-supported choice distinct from private custom sink injection.

Inspect gateway_language_cases separately: require selected Python SDK gateway triplet in its consumed profile, do not force Python API variables on the source-backed Go native OTLP/HTTP route, and keep actual runtime config/resource binding/receipt/active-connection/cloud proof absent. Dated standard exporter/Go API and Studio receiver source receipts are capability evidence only. Preserve every prior thirteen criterion.

Reconcile every requested source/captured case and known request control with generated evidence. Actual omitted model temperature, provided vendor-guide URL/date or complete registry hash, and concrete fictional compatibility selection remain failures. Accurate supplemental Markdown assessments satisfy separate synthetic finish-reason and signal cases without requiring a particular JSON case list; still demand actual field/route/value/application-scope judgments and preserve machine-readable overall review plus canonical-state separation.

Inspect the source/probe case ledger and reconcile its current decisions across all generated evidence. Grouped Markdown, JSON or linked equivalent evidence is accepted when every distinct function constraint/decision remains explicit; do not require separate machine-readable rows or mechanical receipt repetition. A current converter message gap must be applied to the owning safe tool, while finite normal iteration is assessed against its supplied bound rather than treated as unbounded. For native signals, demand actual route and available record-field judgments. Present well-formed log correlation IDs are field support only when the supplied trace record lacks IDs to establish an owning-span match; fabricated correlation, receiver acceptance or app/runtime proof fails.
rubric: Selects the supported default Splunk AO producer only for the genuinely fresh app.py and stdout_dependency_only_fresh cases with no actual source-active or launch-bootstrapped OTel/Galileo/AO instrumentation. Preserves every active signal producer/provider/exporter in existing OTel, Galileo, AO export-only, generic OTel, metrics-only, logs-only and external-launcher cases even when GenAI coverage is absent. Adds only source-proven missing GenAI operations and same-span safe content/attributes through supported existing-stack or OTel hooks, with no AO span-creation SDK dependency, producer migration, replacement provider or duplicate destination exporter. A dependency/import alone and separate eval-only process do not prove active instrumentation; a real generic or single-signal SDK does. Missing GenAI coverage remains a gap in each preserved case rather than being mislabeled covered.

Assesses applicable safe content and vendor fields as required acceptance per captured operation, preserving official Opt-In provenance and distinguishing actual fixture evidence from runtime configuration. Preserve a supplied stricter capture policy; if none is supplied, mark configuration Not proven and give a precise pre-export acceptance test per producer/export path: name the pre-SDK redaction/schema hook, specify numeric proposed UTF-8 byte/message/part limits or an explicit test against documented configured limits, require schema-valid useful content with truthful truncation/gap handling, and test credential/token/email sentinel absence over native records, attributes/events and wire as applicable. Unrun tests remain Not proven, not observed configuration or emission. Exact default numbers are not prescribed by OTel and unknown existing values must not be invented. Generic bounded wording claimed as complete, missing source-content applicability, metadata-only placeholders or forbidden raw content remain failures.

Reconciles the supplied dated official OTel requirements/schemas with both Galileo and Splunk AO recommendation sources, identifying exact source provenance and unavailable newer live freshness honestly. Keeps OTel Opt-In levels distinct from the required skill profile, states vendor INTERNAL-agent provider and tool arguments/input-message plus result/output-message mappings or supported OpenInference equivalents, and uses current typed-parts schemas. Embedded system-role history is not fabricated as separate API instructions. Do not fail only because equivalent evidence appears in prose or another artifact instead of a specific table. When the supplied snapshot provides them, records both exact vendor guide URLs and capture dates in any generated evidence artifact; naming the snapshot or generic vendor comparison alone is not exact guide provenance.

Names source-backed SplunkAOLogger creators, a supported public Splunk AO OTel span helper or a supported matching framework integration at actual fresh agent/model/tool/applicable workflow boundaries, and preserves exact existing hooks for instrumented cases. Records a concrete official example file path, snapshot or live resolved revision/date and a matching installed or explicitly proposed SDK version/API. The supplied dated official-main snapshot is valid offline source evidence when identified as such; live networking and successful SDK installation are not required in this task. Unknown live freshness/runtime support remains Not proven. A directory URL or an unsupported claim that latest main was checked is insufficient; processor-only setup does not create GenAI operations. Treat fixed two-component, pre-release or major-only programming-library/SDK selectors in future guidance as release recipes too; replace them with task-time compatible API/capability checks, while retaining exact dated captured or actually selected versions as scoped provenance. A shortened historical threshold must not become a compatibility rule merely because it is not a three-component release.

Assesses each source case and the separate captured-evidence case without laundering fixture facts into app.py. Preserves one producer/node and actual parentage, safe tool-call/conversation correlation on spans, actual offered definitions and arguments/results, and error/cancel/teardown handling. App.py may correctly have no independent auxiliary operation, but the supplied synthetic auxiliary timeout with no ended inference/error span must be reported as a lifecycle gap. safe-call-1 requires span-only correlation; ordinary HTTP/ASGI/auth/SQL helpers are GenAI N/A. Equivalent explicit lifecycle evidence is accepted without a literal table-row requirement; absent runtime proof remains Not proven. Studio/gateway, live credentials and SDK source edits are unnecessary.

Fails applicable missing content, vendor agent-provider/tool-message gaps and malformed role/content payloads under the required profile; flags separate-process model INTERNAL kind, missing streaming/known temperature, correlation and timeout lifecycle. Recognizes HTTP200/rejectedSpans1 as failed batch acceptance despite cloud complete, treats ordinary helpers as GenAI N/A, and keeps app-code execution/cloud delivery unproven rather than passing fixture-only evidence. Explicitly reconciles the supplied model source temperature0.2 with missing gen_ai.request.temperature on the owning model span, separate from the tool result temperature18. Generic parameter/content wording does not establish that known request-control assessment. Uses per-owning-request expected-versus-captured comparisons for source-known controls, including their actual safe source value when the emitted attribute is absent; an unrelated similarly named tool-result field or generic missing-control category cannot close the request-control assessment.

Separately assesses the installed splunk-ao0.5.0 helper evidence and its proposed resource plan. Recognizes SDK-created parented spans and writable same-tool-span input/output messages without requiring an unsupported logger-private sink adapter: health has an actual result, incident has a successful null represented by output.value and schema-valid null output text, and dependency is ERROR with no produced result/output. Does not claim every field passed: the separate-process LLM remains INTERNAL instead of CLIENT, and isolated in-memory helper evidence is not app integration, actual OTLP acceptance or cloud receipt. Explicitly assesses selected project incident-desk-demo, Agent Stream incident-agent and proposed local gateway routing for the fresh intended SDK app despite absent initialization; keeps names versus unresolved IDs, unimplemented profile loading, missing resource binding and unobserved delivery distinct and Not proven. Does not provision resources or fabricate an existing loader, delegate, resolved IDs, app spans or cloud receipt; proposes precise binding/delivery verification only where evidence is absent.

Explicitly assesses all four independent synthetic usage namespace cases against the complete official registry receipt at its named revision/date/hash: newly proposed gen_ai.usage.total_tokens is unsupported as an official attribute or fresh required field when absent there, while actual supplied gen_ai.usage.input_tokens/output_tokens remain valid applicable counts. Accepts assistant.usage.total_tokens as application-owned derived 12+7=19 with calculation and provider-count provenance rather than silently moving it to a generic HTTP root or mislabeling it standard. Keeps heuristic estimated usage distinct from observed provider counts, with an identified calculation/app-owned estimate field and no fabricated actual count or zero. Preserves and labels the supplied existing native legacy total alias because its source-backed consumer reads that exact key; does not require deletion, silent rename or migration of that existing contract, and does not generalize its compatibility to newly instrumented unrelated spans. Names registry provenance and assesses the actual field values/producer state, not just a generic statement to consult OTel. Does not attribute synthetic case fields to app.py/the real SDK or pass full GenAI/app/export/cloud coverage from these field examples. Records the supplied complete registry SHA256 as source provenance in generated Markdown/JSON or equivalent linked receipt; a snapshot filename or revision/date alone does not reproduce the supplied hash.

Assesses the independent operation metadata and creation-capability cases by source applicability: missing applicable fixed single-model gen_ai.request.model on invoke_agent is Recommended by OTel and required by the selected applicable profile, while missing available gen_ai.agent.name/gen_ai.conversation.id on execute_tool are conditional-field gaps, with known gen_ai.tool.description identified as recommended and applicable under the selected profile; confirms the corresponding present fields without claiming all content/runtime passed, and keeps unavailable standalone-tool metadata N/A without invention. Explicitly distinguishes SDK helper start-time INTERNAL/empty attributes from a corrected completed exported CLIENT/semantic field view, discloses the chosen helper public API limit for attribute-dependent head sampling/on_start observers and uses the scoped recorded creation inputs and identifies remaining application-dependent sampling acceptance where unproven rather than claiming an observed attribute-dependent success/DROP. Does not invent start arguments, mutate SDK internals, add duplicate operations or force an existing valid OTel producer migration. Still records the creation-time recommendation limit under supplied AlwaysOn/no-dependent-consumer mode without turning it into an automatic whole-app failure; preserves source-supported public OTel initial attribute/kind behavior as separate source capability. None of these synthetic fields/cases prove app.py execution, the actual demo app, cloud delivery or every GenAI field. For the dynamic/multiple-model agent case, follows the exact current agent-model condition: standard agent gen_ai.request.model is N/A/should not be populated, with its source reason; actual model request.model and optional app-owned selected-model attribution stay separate. Does not require that agent field merely because an invocation model argument is available. Also flags missing source-configured gen_ai.agent.description when available while leaving unavailable descriptions uninvented. Uses actual captured RecordingAlwaysOn sampler/on_start and finished records as bounded in-memory capability proof; does not mislabel the synthetic corrected CLIENT view as a measured exporter, claim an observed DROP or substitute this probe for app/wire/cloud evidence.

Assesses each independent finish-reason case under current official Recommended provenance and generation-position conditions: known single expected generation with timeout and missing finish reason is a gap requiring ["error"] while no produced output/usage remains absent; the corresponding supplied ["error"] is valid field-level support without invented completion or accounting. Unknown generation contract/slot count remains explicitly unavailable rather than inventing choice.count, generation positions or ["error"] for every arbitrary failure. For two source-known candidate slots, preserves positional ["stop","error"] and the genuinely received complete/partial messages in separate choices on ERROR. Does not blanket-delete finish reasons or produced partial output, synthesize unseen output, make unavailable usage zero, or pass app/runtime/cloud coverage from these isolated field examples. Accurate separately evidenced assessments of all four cases in supplemental Markdown satisfy this criterion even if supplemental JSON groups them; no specific JSON case list or invented canonical live findings is required.

Explicitly assesses supported public decorators first at safe uncovered sync-tool, async-agent, retriever and finite-yielding-agent functions using exact dated source/probe capabilities for capture/fields/lifecycle/sink, not dispatcher syntax alone. Prefers SDK @log when its supported public configuration meets the source contract; otherwise uses only an exact justified application-owned function decorator invoking the supported public SDK helper on the same operation. Assesses measured raw mapped-input sentinel capture, send/asend value loss, variadic argument loss, successful-null-to-empty capture and produced-partial-to-empty failure capture separately from unexecuted protocols and synthetic functions. Preserves business values/errors/parent lifetime and bounded native content, without private sink edits or duplicate operations. Keeps normal SDK-owned standalone Studio routing source-supported and distinct from unsupported custom application-provider/sink injection and the probe-only ingestion-hook subclass; does not universalize a custom sink or function limitation to all SDK modes/releases. Preserves the already wrapper/framework-owned model producer. Dated native SDK/source facts remain separate from app/runtime/OTLP/cloud proof. Converts the independently supplied actual dated SDK source/probe results into concrete per-case capability decisions now, distinguishing captured dispatch/field/protocol/sink facts and precise observed failures from unexecuted application/wire acceptance. Hypothetical future compatibility cannot replace provided observed facts; remaining full-profile field/sink limits stay explicit rather than being silently promoted to complete SDK coverage. The source/probe ledger must yield present case decisions rather than conditional future policy: apply the supplied converter omission of same-tool input/output messages to safe-sync-tool, and assess finite-yielding-agent against its supplied two-yield bound and ordinary-exhaustion consumer separately from unbounded/protocol-sensitive use. Grouped Markdown/JSON or linked equivalent evidence is valid when each distinct case constraint, decision and supporting receipt remain explicit; separate JSON rows or verbatim source-line recopy are not required.

Distinguishes fixed release numbers in shipped future guidance from exact dated captured or dynamically selected versions in evidence/receipts/lockfiles. Rejects the supplied blanket future hardcoded library pin; requires newest compatible dependency resolution within actual Python/project/lock constraints, selected-version API inspection and concrete version/revision/date/constraint provenance without inventing live freshness. Correctly evaluates the fictional compatibility matrix: selected1.1 is newest compatible with Python3.12 while2.0 requires3.13, and historical1.0 must not be forced merely from guidance. Preserves dated actual SDK/helper version receipts as scoped evidence, not a latest or default pin; no unsupported runtime upgrade, unrelated lock overwrite or forced release is justified. Explicitly records the supplied concrete fictional candidate/constraint/selection decision in generated evidence; a generic latest-compatible policy alone is not assessment of this case.

Requires normal native traces, metrics and application LogRecords to the discovered Studio OTLP routes unless the user explicitly opted out. Flags unasked OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=none even when SDK @log GenAI spans and metrics exist; @log creates spans, not normal application LogRecords, and console output does not prove OTLP logs. Separately checks log provider/handler/export path, real-app source, safe body/severity/resource/correlation, native signal route acceptance and owned lifecycle while preserving existing console/log sinks. The supplied three-signal synthetic field example is scoped contract support, not actual app/Studio/cloud evidence; actual path proof stays unproven until run. Preserves the explicit supplied user opt-out as intentional log-export N/A and does not invent a none default or falsely claim emission there. Accurate supplemental Markdown, JSON or linked evidence can assess the three-native-signal example; no specific JSON case list is required. It must still assess the actual supplied routes and available LogRecord body/severity/resource/correlation as separate native signal contract support, rather than only saying synthetic packets are unproven. Assess available logger scope and distinguish correlation-field presence from a matched owning span: the supplied log IDs are nonzero correctly sized fields, but the trace record has no IDs proving that match. Do not pass actual correlation merely from plausible IDs or the shared service name. Unknown provider/handler/export lifecycle and route acceptance remain separate missing gates even when the synthetic route/body/severity/resource subset is supported.

Assesses all three independent gateway-language cases against their actual producer/runtime and dated public source receipts: selected Python Splunk AO SDK standalone gateway with blank consumed SPLUNK_AO_API_URL/CONSOLE_URL/API_KEY is Not configured, while the populated nondefault discovered-base triplet gives source-field support only. The separate Go native OTLP/HTTP source uses standard trace endpoint/protocol/paired projectid-logstreamid header configuration; absent Python SDK environment alone must not falsely yield Not configured or force an invented Python SDK adapter/API-key login. Still checks consumed effective profile, actual supported transport/auth, selected resource identities and ownership, per-request binding, native-loopback routing and partial-success acceptance; loader/SDK/real-resource/runtime/receiver/active-connection/cloud proof remain Not proven where absent. Preserves Python gateway requirements and generic routing/resource gates without attributing synthetic selectors/source fields to app.py or claiming latest installed compatibility from dated source.
